# FloatLogSlider { #anylumino.FloatLogSlider }

```python
FloatLogSlider(
    value=1.0,
    base=10.0,
    min=0.0,
    max=4.0,
    step=0.1,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    orientation='horizontal',
    readout=True,
    readout_format='.3g',
)
```

Logarithmic float slider control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default        |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `1.0` |
| base | optional | Logarithm base for logarithmic sliders. | `10.0` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `0.0` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `4.0` |
| step | optional | Increment size. | `0.1` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| orientation | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``. | `'horizontal'` |
| readout | optional | Whether to show the current value. | `True` |
| readout_format | optional | Format string used for slider readouts. | `'.3g'` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.FloatLogSlider.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
